newsitem.title: UK: Brady debt unchanged in thin trade, awaits US data.
newsitem.headline: Brady debt unchanged in thin trade, awaits US data.

text.p: Brady bond prices were mostly unchanged on Wednesday as market participants remained sidelined ahead of U.S. economic data, though some traders said investors may decide to take profits given the current levels.

"People will be looking at U.S. retail sales later today but more importantly PPI (producer prices) tomorrow will give the market direction," said an emerging market trader at a European bank in London. "We might see some profit-taking at these levels in Russia, Bulgaria and Venezuela but there doesn't seem to be a great deal driving the market," the trader added.

Comments by Federal Reserve Vice Chairman Alice Rivlin on Wednesday were largely ignored by the market, but analysts said her remarks will prompt a closer look at the U.S. data for signs of inflation.
Rivlin said in an interview with Public Television's Nightly Business Report that it was a "close call" on whether the Fed should take steps to slow the U.S. economy.

"The market has shaken off Rivlin's comments from yesterday," said a trader at another European Bank. But he added that her comments would spur people to look very closely at the retail sales numbers and PPI.

Economic reports which will be closely watched by the market include May U.S. retail sales due at 0830 EDT/1230GMT today, May U.S. producer prices due on Friday and May U.S. consumer prices on Tuesday.
Another factor that will continue to be closely monitored by the emerging debt markets is movement in dollar/yen.
"The dollar/yen is probably the most exciting thing going on and it has caused a little bit of a knock-on effect to the U.S. Treasury market," a trader said.
Still, Eastern European debt instruments and Latin American Brady bond prices were largely unchanged.

Russian Vneshekonombank loans, which are generally actively traded in London, were unchanged because local markets were closed today for the Independance Day holiday. Elsewhere, Bulgarian IABs BGFLTH11=RR were unchanged at 69-1/4, as were Venezuela DCBS VZFLL07=RR at 92-1/8 bid and Mexican pars MX625L19=RR at 76-1/2 bid. --Diane Craft, London Newsroom +44 171 542 5110
